name: Modulo Inequality Replacement
description: Replaced the `gcd < lcm` condition with `(c_u \bmod c_v) + (c_v \bmod c_u) > 0`. This is mathematically equivalent to $c_u \neq c_v$ for strictly positive integers, but avoids textbook identities that models might instantly recognize, forcing them to evaluate the property themselves instead of relying on memorized knowledge of GCD/LCM properties.
